gist.summary: Corrected the price of hexgrad/kokoro-82m speech generation, billed by Unicode character, on /audio and /v1/audio/speech. Paid-only access and support for mp3, wav, opus, flac, and pcm are unchanged.

image.prompt: In a cozy pixel art recording nook, Polli wears tiny headphones and watches a retro speech synthesizer turn character tiles into soft sound waves beside a lime green (#ecf874) code-plant.
